==English==
{{wp}}
{{wikiquote}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:inh|enm:frendschipe|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|frendschipe}}, {{m|enm|frendshipe}}, from {{inh|en|ang|frēondsċiepe}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*friundskapi}}. Equivalent to {{af|en|friend|-ship}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|frĕn(d)'shĭp}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈfɹɛn(d)ʃɪp/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-friendship.ogg|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The [[condition]] of being [[friend]]s.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1816|origyear=1777|quotee=w:Samuel Johnson|title=The life of Samuel Johnson{{...}}|volume=3|author=w:James Boswell|publisher=T. Cadell and W. Davies|page=181|url=https://books.google.co.nz/books?id=fcIIAAAAQAAJ|passage=We cannot tell the precise moment when '''friendship''' is formed. As in filling a vessel drop by drop, there is at last a drop which makes it run over; so in a series of kindnesses there is at last one which makes the heart run over.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Sarah Molano|title=Most romantic relationships start as friendships, study finds|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/07/20/health/romantic-relationships-start-as-friends-wellness/index.html|date=2021-07-20|passage=“They’re cuddling by the fire, they’re going on trips together, they’re introducing their friends to their family, but they’re very clear that those are friendships,” Stinson said. “It really makes me think about the definitions that we have about '''friendship''' and romance, and how those things differ, and I just like how messy it all is.”|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220304095139/https://www.cnn.com/2021/07/20/health/romantic-relationships-start-as-friends-wellness/index.html}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[friendly]] [[relationship]], or a relationship as friends.
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Sarah Molano|title=Most romantic relationships start as friendships, study finds|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/07/20/health/romantic-relationships-start-as-friends-wellness/index.html|date=2021-07-20|passage=“They’re cuddling by the fire, they’re going on trips together, they’re introducing their friends to their family, but they’re very clear that those are '''friendships''',” Stinson said. “It really makes me think about the definitions that we have about friendship and romance, and how those things differ, and I just like how messy it all is.”|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220304095139/https://www.cnn.com/2021/07/20/health/romantic-relationships-start-as-friends-wellness/index.html}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Terry Ward|title=Fragile and complex, female friendships hinge on the three S’s, a new book says|url=https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/04/health/fragile-female-friendship-wellness/index.html|date=2024-08-04|passage=
In good times and bad, in sickness and health, the benefits of '''friendships''' between women are physically and psychologically undeniable.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240822053413/https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/04/health/fragile-female-friendship-wellness/index.html}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} {{U|good will}}.
